name: Supreme Immolator
body:
Your immolation ability has reached a near-fatal level.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro immolation special torch attack class feature, Master Immolator.

Benefit(s): Your immolation special torch attack ability inflicts d8 additional damage per round (e.g., 1d8, 2d8, 3d8, 4d8, 5d8).
